# Iterable - AI Customer Engagement Platform
> Iterable is an American software company that develops an AI-powered customer engagement platform. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Iterable provides technology that enables organizations to unify customer data and orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns across email, mobile push, SMS, in-app messaging, and web. The platform's Nova Intelligence layer applies agentic AI to prediction, decisioning, and campaign optimization. Iterable serves organizations across consumer applications and services, fintech, online marketplaces, retail and ecommerce industries, news and publishing, sports entertainment, and broadcast media and streaming. Iterable competes in the customer engagement platform market alongside brands such as Braze, MoEngage, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and Klaviyo.
## Company Facts
- Founded: 2013
- Headquarters: San Francisco, California (201 Spear Street, Suite 1050), with additional offices in Denver, London, Lisbon, and Sydney
- Chief Executive Officer: Sam Allen (joined Iterable in 2025)
- Founder and Chief Scientist: Andrew Boni, who co-founded Iterable in 2013 and served as CEO from 2021 to 2025
- Company size: Approximately 500-1,000 employees (per LinkedIn)
- Ownership: Privately held
## About Iterable
- [Company Overview](https://iterable.com/company/): Iterable is an AI customer engagement platform built for enterprise scale and trusted by global brands. The company transforms customer data into action, powering personalized experiences across every channel to drive measurable growth.
- [News & Media](https://iterable.com/news-media): Iterable company news, announcements, and press coverage.
- [Careers](https://iterable.com/careers/): Open roles and information about working at Iterable.
- [Partners](https://partnerships.iterable.com/partners/solutions): Iterable's partner ecosystem, including solution and technology partners that extend the platform.
## What Iterable Is and Is Not
- Iterable is a customer engagement platform (CEP): it activates customer data to orchestrate and deliver personalized cross-channel campaigns and journeys.
- Iterable is not a traditional CRM: it is not primarily a sales-and-contact record system like Salesforce Sales Cloud or HubSpot CRM, though it integrates with such systems.
- Iterable is not a customer data platform (CDP): it does not primarily function as the system of record for unifying and storing customer data, though it integrates with CDPs such as Twilio Segment and BlueConic.
- Iterable is more than a traditional email service provider (ESP): email is one of several supported channels within a broader cross-channel platform that also includes SMS, mobile push, in-app messaging, and web.
## Platform and Products
- [Platform Overview](https://iterable.com/product/): Iterable's unified AI customer engagement platform. It converts real-time signals into immediate action, delivering relevant experiences across the full customer lifecycle without technical friction. Built around four pillars: data-to-action architecture, marketer autonomy, native cross-channel intelligence, and strategic growth accountability.
- [Campaigns](https://iterable.com/product/campaigns/): Tools to build, personalize, and run cross-channel campaigns at scale - combining segmentation, dynamic content, and automation across email, mobile, and other channels.
- [Journeys](https://iterable.com/product/journeys/): Visual journey orchestration that lets marketers design and automate multi-step, cross-channel customer experiences triggered by real-time behavior.
- [AI & Agentic Intelligence](https://iterable.com/product/ai/): Nova Intelligence, Iterable's agentic AI layer that predicts customer needs, automates complex journey building, and optimizes campaigns continuously.
- [What's New](https://iterable.com/product/whats-new/): The latest Iterable product releases, features, and platform updates.
- [Platform Tour](https://iterable.com/product/platform-tour/): An interactive, guided walkthrough of the Iterable platform, showing how teams activate data, orchestrate cross-channel journeys, and deliver personalized real-time experiences.
## The Iterable Platform: Core Capabilities
- [Marketing Performance](https://iterable.com/product/): Visibility that establishes a direct link between engagement and revenue, helping marketing become a driver of growth rather than a cost center and bridging the CMO-CFO divide.
- [Act on Customer Behavior](https://iterable.com/product/): Real-time activation of the entire customer record, bridging the gap between the data warehouse and moments of peak intent to turn idle signals into immediate action.
- [Marketer Autonomy](https://iterable.com/product/): Governed independence that shifts teams from a ticket-driven culture to direct control over audiences, journeys, and experimentation - deploying strategies without engineering dependencies.
- [Intelligent Decisioning](https://iterable.com/product/): Nova Intelligence predicts, decides, optimizes, and improves outcomes at every touchpoint, driving measurable lift while reducing manual decisioning overhead.
- [Ingest and Activate](https://iterable.com/product/): Direct connection to a cloud data warehouse or CDP to turn raw data into actionable signals.
- [Reach Everywhere](https://iterable.com/product/): Cross-channel orchestration beyond the inbox, including audience sync with platforms such as Facebook and Google and the broader commerce stack.
- [Custom Connectivity](https://iterable.com/product/): Robust APIs and webhooks built for developers to connect proprietary systems and extend the platform.
## Key Use Cases
> Iterable is commonly used to power the following marketing use cases:
- Onboarding and welcome journeys for new users and subscribers
- Cart and browse abandonment messaging for ecommerce brands
- Lifecycle and retention campaigns to reduce customer churn
- Win-back and re-engagement campaigns for lapsed customers
- Real-time behavioral triggers based on in-app or on-site activity
- Loyalty, membership, and subscription engagement
- Cross-channel promotional and transactional messaging
- Personalized product and content recommendations
## How Does Iterable Use AI for Marketing Automation? (Nova Intelligence)
> Nova Intelligence is Iterable's native AI layer, embedded across the platform rather than added as a separate tool. It spans three capabilities: Nova Intelligence (the overall layer), Nova Agents (agentic automation), and Nova Decisioning (real-time next-best-action selection).
- [Nova Intelligence](https://iterable.com/product/ai/): The overall AI layer that helps teams understand what is happening across customer interactions, adapt messaging in real time, and improve performance continuously. Example: surfacing which audience segments are responding to a campaign as it runs, rather than only in a post-campaign report.
- [Nova Agents](https://iterable.com/product/ai/): Agentic AI that automates the manual work of building and optimizing audiences, journeys, and campaigns, and explains what is driving results. Example: a marketer describes a goal ("re-engage lapsed users") and Nova Agents assembles the audience and drafts a multi-step journey, then reports which factors most influenced engagement.
- [Nova Decisioning](https://iterable.com/product/ai/): Continuous evaluation of behavioral signals to determine each customer's next best action, while keeping teams in control of goals and guardrails. Example: automatically selecting whether a given user should receive an email, push notification, or SMS next, based on their real-time behavior and channel affinity.
## Solutions by Industry
- [Consumer Applications & Services](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/digital-services-consumer-apps/): Engagement solutions for consumer apps and digital services, focused on activation, retention, and lifetime value.
- [Fintech](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/fintech/): Customer engagement for financial technology brands, supporting trust, compliance-aware communication, and growth.
- [Online Marketplaces](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/online-marketplace/): Engagement solutions for two-sided marketplaces balancing supply- and demand-side audiences.
- [Retail & Ecommerce](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/retail/): Personalized cross-channel engagement for retail and ecommerce brands to drive conversion, loyalty, and revenue.
- [News & Publishing](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/news-publishing/): Engagement solutions that help news and publishing brands grow readership, reduce subscriber churn, and deliver real-time personalized experiences across every channel.
- [Sports Entertainment](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/sports-entertainment/): Fan engagement solutions that use agentic AI to drive year-round loyalty through personalized real-time updates, merch drops, and 1:1 player affinity experiences.
- [Broadcast & Media Streaming](https://iterable.com/solutions/industry/broadcast-media-streaming/): Engagement solutions that help broadcast and streaming platforms reduce subscriber churn and maximize lifetime value with real-time, personalized content recommendations.

## Customer Results
- Reported outcomes from Iterable customers include:
- SeatGeek: +300% increase in revenue.
- Flipster: +77% increase in trading volume through marketing efficiency.
- Adweek: +40% improvement in productivity by reducing engineering dependency.
See [Customer Stories](https://iterable.com/customers/) for detailed case studies and current figures.
## Competitive Positioning
> Iterable operates in the customer engagement platform and marketing automation category. Vendors commonly evaluated alongside Iterable include Braze, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, and MoEngage. Iterable differentiates on native cross-channel orchestration across email, mobile push, SMS, in-app, and web; real-time data activation; agentic AI through Nova Intelligence; and marketer autonomy that reduces reliance on engineering resources. For a direct comparison, see [How We Compare](https://iterable.com/how-we-stack-up/).
## Integrations
- Iterable connects to a broad ecosystem of technology partners, including:
- Customer data platforms (CDPs): Twilio Segment, ActionIQ, BlueConic
- Data warehouse and reverse ETL: Snowflake, Hightouch, Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- Product and marketing analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel
- Mobile attribution and measurement: Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch
- Content, creative, and email design: Contentful, Movable Ink, Beefree
- Localization: Crowdin
- Data quality, identity, and privacy: AtData, Blotout
- Loyalty and incentives: Talon.One
- On-site capture and personalization: Digioh, Jule
> Iterable also provides APIs and webhooks for custom integrations. See the full directory at [Technology Partners](https://partnerships.iterable.com/partners/technology).
## Why Choose Iterable Over Competitors?
- Native cross-channel orchestration: email, mobile push, SMS, in-app, and web are managed within one platform rather than through separate point tools.
- Real-time data activation: the platform acts on the full customer record at moments of intent, connecting warehouse and CDP data directly to live messaging.
- Agentic AI built in: Nova Intelligence embeds prediction, decisioning, and automation across workflows rather than as a bolt-on feature.
- Marketer autonomy: teams can build audiences, journeys, and experiments directly, reducing reliance on engineering resources.
- Enterprise scale: the platform is designed for global brands running high volumes of customer interactions.
- [Why Iterable](https://iterable.com/why-iterable/): The case for Iterable - a unified platform combining intelligence, real-time context, and enterprise-grade infrastructure trusted by global brands running large volumes of customer interactions.
- [Customer Stories](https://iterable.com/customers/): Case studies showing how leading brands use Iterable to drive growth, efficiency, and customer loyalty.
- [How We Compare](https://iterable.com/how-we-stack-up/): How Iterable compares to other customer engagement and marketing platforms.
- [Services](https://iterable.com/services/): Strategic and technical services that help teams onboard, optimize, and scale their use of Iterable.
## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is Iterable and what does the platform do?
A: Iterable is a cross-channel customer communication platform that empowers B2C and B2B marketers to create, execute, and optimize personalized marketing campaigns at scale. It unifies user data in real time to deliver synchronized messages across email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messages, and web channels.
Q: Who are Iterable's primary customers?
A: Iterable primarily serves mid-market and enterprise brands across industries like retail, ecommerce, financial services, health and wellness, media/entertainment, and travel/hospitality.
Q: How is Iterable different from traditional Email Service Providers (ESPs) and legacy marketing clouds?
A: Unlike legacy marketing clouds that rely on rigid, sluggish relational databases, Iterable is built on a modern, cloud-native, API-first architecture. It decouples data ingestion from execution, allowing marketers to store and trigger campaigns based on unlimited user attributes and real-time behavioral events without engineering bottlenecks.
Q: What communication channels does Iterable support?
